import type postgres from 'postgres';
import {dbOf} from './module-db.ts';
const sql=dbOf('publication');
type Part = postgres.PendingQuery<postgres.Row[]>;
type Both = Part | number;
function aliasFragment(p:Part) { return sql`${p}`; }
function unionFragment(p:Both) { return sql`${p}`; }
function directFragment(p:postgres.PendingQuery<postgres.Row[]>) { return sql`${p}`; }
export function aliasParameter(p:Part) { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${aliasFragment(p)}`; }
export function unionParameter(p:Both) { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${unionFragment(p)}`; }
export function directParameter(p:postgres.PendingQuery<postgres.Row[]>) { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${directFragment(p)}`; }
export function literalControl(n:number) { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${numericFragment(n)}`; }
function numericFragment(n:number) { return sql`p.id = ${n}`; }
function compound(q:{part:Part}) { return sql`${q.part}`; }
export function compoundParameter(q:{part:Part}) { return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${compound(q)}`; }


type Parts=Part[];
function arrayFragment(p:Parts){return sql`${p}`;}
export function arrayParameter(p:Parts){return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${arrayFragment(p)}`;}
